create_BenchmarkReducer_subclass: create a subclass of BenchmarkReducer implementing join_results, save_results, compute_metrics, save_metrics, and log_metrics abstract methods
run_BenchmarkReducer_reduce: run the reduce method to join results, compute metrics, save and log metrics for a benchmark
create_JsonDFReducer: create a JsonDFReducer instance with a benchmark name and optional target data path to reduce JSON result files into DataFrames
compute_JsonDFReducer_metrics: compute mean absolute error and cosine similarity metrics for forces and other target keys from joined results
join_JsonDFReducer_results: join multiple JSON result files from a results directory into a single pandas DataFrame using glob patterns
